title: Example 1: Customer Purchases and City Insights

blocks.content: Example 1: Customer Purchases and City Insights
To list customers, their cities, and purchased products, you need to select the customer name and city from the Customers table and the product from the Orders table.
You can use an INNER JOIN to combine these tables on the customer_id as:

1-- Join the Customers and Orders table
2-- Select customer_name, city, and product_name
3
4SELECT Customers.customer_name, Customers.city, Orders.product_name
5FROM Customers
6INNER JOIN Orders
7ON Customers.customer_id = Orders.customer_id;
